reasonBound.unit: UTF-16 code units of the TRIMMED string: String.prototype.length after .trim(). maxLength counts UTF-16 code units of the raw value (HTML code-unit length), so the same unit; because trim only shortens, any value the input allows (raw <= 2000) has a trimmed length <= 2000 and passes the upper bound. Not bytes.
